requirements.subject: company
requirements.citation_text: A U.S.-, Canada-, Mexico-, or non-North America-domiciled motor carrier conducting operations in interstate commerce must file a Motor Carrier Identification Report, Form MCS–150.
requirements.requirement_text: An interstate motor carrier subject to the identification-report rule must maintain the required FMCSA motor-carrier identification filings and updates.
requirements.notes: The operative provision is §390.19T; base §390.19 remains suspended in the current regulatory text. The associated biennial-update schedule must be implemented separately.
